name: Guillotine (Deathless)

abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.

signatureAbility:
Ancestor's Strength
The Souls of her ancestors empower Guillotine further, granting a 10% chance to steal [20 - 55]% of damage done as Health for every 4 Souls she possesses. Minimum [20 - 55]% Health Steal regardless of current Soul count.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Start each fight with 4 Souls. Each Soul grants Guillotine +[85.05] Critical Damage Rating. 1 Soul expires every 10 seconds. Souls are treated as Cruelty Passives for all other abilities.
For every 5% of Max Health that Guillotine removes from her Opponent during combat, she feeds her ancestral blade and gains 1 Soul.

abilitySections.title: Critical Hits
content: If the hit was not Blocked, inflict a Degeneration Debuff, dealing [15,521.73] Direct Damage over 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final hit inflicts a 200% Spectre Debuff for 10 seconds, then consumes 2 Souls.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: La Fleur du Mal deals 2% of the Opponent's Max Health in Direct Damage per Soul. After this attack, 50% of Guillotine's Souls are consumed, rounded down.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Ancestor's Strength
